title: Power Pages: enhanced authorisation maps web roles and site users to Dataverse security
summary: The briefing is held because it says enhanced authorization has no documented automation control, while Microsoft documents a writable enhancedauthorization field and a Dataverse Web API update operation for the site. The roadmap facts, enablement path, licensing and qualified auditing statements are supported. The governance checklist also names controls missing from the table.

claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api with kind rest, call 'PATCH /powerpagesites(<powerpagesiteid>)', and docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/reference/entities/powerpagesite'. Add the note 'The request body sets enhancedauthorization; documented values are 0 (Disabled), 1 (Migration in progress), 2 (Migration Failed), and 3 (Enabled). The reference documents updating the site-state field, not the migration workflow.' Replace 'no equivalent automation control was found as of November 2026' with 'The Dataverse Site table reference documents updating the enhancedauthorization field through PATCH /powerpagesites(<powerpagesiteid>).' Keep the rendered table consistent and cite that reference.
